_doc: Each entry is {id, fields, reason, plan_ref}. fields names the old /api/live fields (or the new timeline fields) whose values may differ from the recorded answer. reason says why. plan_ref points to the plan section that allows it. Any difference outside these entries fails.

differences.reason: Runs not started at T appear on the new timeline. The old answer at T never lists one, because Live at T is Live at now.
The old "done" reads as finished, and the new run states are working, idle and finished.

differences.plan_ref: m2-build.md section 6, allowed difference 3, as amended in section 12
differences.reason: label_n follows first-seen order and never renames a shown row, so the old route's "scout" with one run and "scout 1" with two both read "scout" here. together counts the whole session.
Buckets cover the whole session at bucket_seconds. Only the minutes inside the old 30-minute window are compared, and only when bucket_seconds is 60.
Model names are ids. The old model_display is not compared.
In the page-at-T oracle, "last minute" is the bucket that holds T, not a rolling 60 seconds.

The old answer counts every request stamped at or before T, and the flow builds put a request on most minute marks. The page-at-T oracle takes the requests the old answer lists at exactly T out of its numbers first.

Cumulative numbers are bucket-granular. The page-at-T oracle compares per-run and total tokens and cost only at a T that falls on a bucket boundary. States, parents and rounds are compared at every T.

Several runs can share one route key, and the old answer does not say which run a request at exactly T belongs to. The page-at-T oracle skips per-run numbers for a shared route key only when a request at exactly T carries that key, and checks every other run.
A bucket holds [start, end), so a request stamped exactly on a boundary falls in the bucket that starts there, and the picker leaves it out at that T. The old answer counts ts <= T.
The old route has no session list across projects, so /api/live/sessions has no oracle. Its tests use crafted stores.
